description: Exports the open CIVIL NX model to IFC with the Model to IFC plugin: real section outlines with voids, smooth tapers, tendons, composite deck slabs, materials, structure groups and stages; in IFC4.3 also the bridge structure (deck, piers, abutments, bearings, alignment); optionally the structural analysis model with loads, combinations, support reactions, and — for the series named in resultSeries — node displacements and member/plate forces; optionally a second file of the deformed shape for one load case or combination. Only reads the model. Returns download links (never the file inline) and the exporter's report (sections, volumes, bridge parts, checks). Results are read on demand and can take long on big models (one live model: 40 s for all displacements), which is why this runs as a job.

analysis.description: Include the structural analysis model (nodes, supports, members, links).

classification.description: {name, edition, codes: {<role>: {code, title}}} e.g. Uniclass codes per role (girder, deck slab, pier stem, pier cap, abutment wall, pile, bearing, tendon…).

deformed.description: {series, scale}: also write the deformed shape for one load case or combination as its own IFC (scale omitted = automatic, the largest movement drawn at about 5% of the bridge's size).

georef.description: {crs (e.g. EPSG:27700), eastings, northings, height, rotation (deg), scale}: IfcMapConversion. Omitted = none.

joinDeck.description: Join side-by-side girders' slab strips into one continuous deck.

linearPlacement.description: IFC4.3 only: place members along the alignment (IfcLinearPlacement).

loads.description: Load cases, self-weight, nodal/beam/pressure loads and combinations (with analysis).

name.description: File / model name (default: the model's project name).

reactions.description: Support reactions for every analysed series (with analysis; needs an analysed model).

resultSeries.description: Load cases / combinations (exact names) whose results to add: node displacements and member and plate forces. None by default — they multiply by elements × points × series.

schema.description: IFC4: Revit, Navisworks, Tekla, Solibri. IFC4X3: the bridge model (IfcBridge parts, bearings, alignment).

separateSlabs.description: A composite section's deck slab as its own slab.

skipWeightless.description: Leave out weightless (dummy) members; cables, piles and members named NoSW are kept.

startStation.description: Chainage at the start of the deck, m.

tendons.description: Tendons drawn at their duct diameter.

name: model_to_ifc
title: Model to IFC — export the model to IFC4 / IFC4.3
